purpose: Evaluation briefs, not training data or generation templates. The app never reads this file. Unrun cases must not be described as successful AI results.

cases.brief: A compact desk sensor with an orange bracket. The ESP32 radio module must sit on the carrier board inside the housing, not floating separately.
A small desktop fan with an exposed three-blade rotor, a circular grille, an adjustable tilted stand and a visible speed knob. Include a sourced 608 bearing on the fan axle.
A smart sofa with an iron base and an ESP32 controller.
An articulated inspection lamp with two hinged arms, a round steel base and a visible power button.
A manual coffee grinder with a transparent bean hopper, side crank and removable grounds cup.
A game controller with two thumbsticks, a directional pad, four face buttons and a separate battery compartment.
A folding phone stand with two hinges and a charging cable opening.
A mirrorless camera with a detachable lens, a side memory card door and a visible shutter button.
A handheld vacuum with a translucent dust bin, an accessible filter and a trigger on its handle.
A wall-mounted sensor hub with an ESP32, a vented enclosure and four mounting holes.
A mechanical keyboard with individually selectable keycaps, separate switch and plate layers and a USB port at the back.
A steel frame with an attached electronics tray and a radio module mounted on the tray. Widen the frame while preserving the other component geometry.
